mara: FYI ran into a nasty edge with the sampleapp rerank flow — JS SDK + auth retry combo yields vectors of length 1025 intermittently and downstream rerank throws 

jin: wait 1025? that sounds like an off-by-one padding somewhere :facepalm:

mara: yep. repro is flaky but triggered when we hit a 401 on a batch call and the SDK's retry path rebuilds the payload. most batches are fine, a few end up with an extra null appended.

sam: can you paste the request body you saw?

mara: here's the weird bit (redacted keys):
```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-1",
  "inputs": [[0.1, 0.2, ..., 0.0], /* length 1025 */],
  "meta": {"sample_id":"abc-123"}
}
```

lina: interesting — our Python helper has an explicit `.slice(dim)` step before sending. JS helper uses typed arrays + concat, maybe concat bug.

mara: also saw the rerank helper assume response.embeddings.length === inputs.length and then zip by index, which explodes when shapes mismatch.

jin: could be two separate issues: (1) retry path duplicates/pads vector, (2) response envelope doesn't include dims so client trusts length only.

sam: short-term mitigation: validate vectors on client before sending and bail if weird length. add a guard in sampleapp.

mara: done that locally, but we should fix SDK parity. linens: can you add a sanitization step in JS SDK batcher to assert dims and throw/trim?

lina: will add a check. question: should we silently trim or error? I lean error so callers are aware.

jin: error + opt-in auto-trim in config. also add idempotency-key header so retries don't duplicate on server side.

mara: adding idempotency helped avoid double-processing but didn't stop the pad. the pad seems to come from `Buffer.concat` + one extra 0 byte turned to a float.

sam: filing an infra ticket to log failed 401->retry payloads at the proxy layer so we can diff. deploy-bot: start a debug trace for sampleapp/flags=embed-repro

deploy-bot: debug trace started for sampleapp/flags=embed-repro, trace id t-1765504321-repro

jin: can you add a small unit test in JS SDK that simulates an auth-fail + retry and asserts vector lengths preserved? if it's deterministic we can catch it in CI.

mara: yep I'll push a tiny mocha test. also adding a small CLI debug command to print out each batch's vector lengths before send: `ri embed-inspect --show-lengths`

lina: on the response side, we should include `embedding_dim` in the envelope from the service so clients can validate server intent. I'll open a short RFC for that.

sam: nice. once we have server-side dim in envelope, clients can verify and surface clearer errors instead of mysterious mismatches.

mara: thanks y'all. plan: (1) mara adds client guard + test, (2) lina patches JS SDK batcher to throw by default, (3) jin adds idempotency recommendation to sampleapp README, (4) infra inspects proxy traces. followups in #devex and I'll ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:

lina: ack, starting a branch now.

sam: ping me on the infra ticket id when it's created, I'll add traces to the rerank service logs.

mara: created issue DEVEX-1129 and pushed test branch `mara/embed-retry-dim-guard`. linking in PR once green.

jin: awesome — thanks for triaging fast.

mara: closing the loop later today, leaving the trace open for a bit.

deploy-bot: trace t-1765504321-repro will expire in 72h.
